Name: AWS Container Cost Allocation
Description:
Setup Documentation ( https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/cost_allocation/container_cost_allocation/?tab=aws )

Prerequisites ( https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/cost_allocation/container_cost_allocation/?tab=aws#prerequisites ) - Requires specific Datadog agent versions and installation

*Note* - The CCM configuration must be in the organization that the containers live in. There is *no cross organization visibility* to container CCM data.
Success Criteria: Once configured costs should begin to flow into the Datadog console

Name: Azure Setup
Description:
Setup Documentation ( https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/setup/azure/?tab=billingaccounts )

Prerequisites required:

* Datadog Azure Integration
* Amortized Cost Report in Azure
* Actual Cost Report in Azure

As of October 23, 2025 Pay As You Go Accounts are in Preview
Success Criteria: Once configured data should start to flow to Datadog.
